entities.title: On a pull request
entities.summary: Samosa is typechecked, tested and built, and every .dev diagram and knowledge file is validated.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes games/dictator outside its .dev folders, or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev (ci.yml, changed-games.sh).
checks: npm test: tsc --noEmit, then build.mjs --test, then the node:test suites in test/ (the clean-room guard among them)
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py, for the whole repository
The Database migration check, when worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change
notChecked: Behavior in a real browser, the touch keypad and the screen-reader text as read aloud.
Parity with the baseline, and the overlap and asset checks: the verify role runs them outside CI.
That vendor/icelander-auth is unedited: Samosa's tests don't call its checkVendored.
A change to vendor/icelander-auth alone: changed-games.sh picks games by changes under games/ or .github/ only, so it runs no game's checks.

entities.title: On a push to main
entities.summary: The same steps again, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: A push to main that changes games/dictator or .github/, or Run workflow on the Deploy workflow.
checks: The migration gate: every database change since the last deploy has been acknowledged
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
